disputes.reason: Ambiguous label: 'use of historical data' is arguably an advantage (data are real and readily available, no parametric assumptions) and a weakness (dependence on the sample); only the bank's EXCEPT framing makes it false, so a standalone True/False judgement is unreliable.
'Filtered historical simulation is fast' is vague and relative (it requires fitting a GARCH-type model and is slower than basic HS); cannot be judged without Dowd's context.
